items.title: £121m Llantrisant Health Park to add six operating theatres and 54 beds in NHS Wales
items.summary: Cwm Taf Morgannwg University Health Board's £121m Llantrisant Health Park will deliver six new operating theatres and 54 beds, targeting around 3,000 operations a year and initially focused on hip and knee replacement, with purpose-built diagnostic and recovery facilities.

items.title: Draeger wins direct-award for an MRI-compatible anaesthetic machine at Wrexham Maelor
items.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has directly awarded Draeger Medical UK Limited a contract for an anaesthetic machine for use within the MRI scanner at Wrexham Maelor Hospital.

items.title: GIRFT study explores volume-outcome relationship for incisional hernia surgery
items.summary: New GIRFT research examines the relationship between the volume of incisional hernia procedures performed and patient outcomes.
